collection.title: VW Passat Estate 2002 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Passat Estate 2002 to 2004 model which requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Passat Estate which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
